title: Ashy Gray Acacia
description: Recolors acacia to match ash bricks
body:
This pack recolors acacia wood to be a warm gray that works well alongside Supplementaries' ash bricks.

![All blocks in the acacia wood set have been recolored to complement the gray of Supplementaries' ash bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70a6b858f5725c50b88145831b1865c812a4d202.jpeg)

It includes compat for the following mods:

- Another Furniture
- Balanced Crates
- Building But Better
- The Block Box
- Boatload
- Bountiful Fares
- Charm
- Cozy
- Create
- Decorative Blocks
- Dramatic Doors
- Farmer's Delight
- Friends & Foes
- Hearth & Home
- Hearth and Harvest
- Lucky's Cozy Home
- Modern Glass Doors
- MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod: Refurbished
- Player Shops
- Quark
- Re:Deco
- Redecorate
- Shutter Up
- Snowy Spirit
- Storage Delight
- Storage Drawers
- Supplementaries
- Tutta's Doors
- Twigs
- Woodworks


If you like this pack, check out my other recolors: [Mossy Green Mangrove](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mossy-green-mangrove) and [Jet-Black Jungle](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/jet-black-jungle)
